$description: Imagine Cities design tokens (W3C DTCG format). Every value is transcribed from Imagine Cities Brand Guidelines v2.0.1 (October 2024) via source/brand-v2.0.1.md. No values from the superseded 2021 Design Guidelines.pdf appear here.

color.$description: Brand palette, v2.0.1 section 2. Gold is the hero colour.

bold-red.$description: RGB 199 49 36 / CMYK 0 75 82 22. Use sparingly — alerts, warnings, emphasis.

action.$description: Semantic alias. Call-to-action buttons, key icons, standout elements.

header.$description: Semantic alias. Headers and secondary elements.

text.$description: Semantic alias. Body and UI text.

background.$description: Semantic alias. Page and surface backgrounds.

tint.$description: Tint stops documented in v2.0.1 section 2.2 for Deep Azure, Gold, Forest Green and Bold Red. These are the documented PERCENTAGES only — the deck presents the resulting tint swatches as a visual chart and their exact hex values were not transcribed. Do not compute or invent tint hexes; sample them from the deck before adding colour tokens for these stops.

20.$description: Used for section backgrounds (gold, azure, forest green) to signify important components.

brand.$description: Brand font. Use for printed materials, hard-copy client deliverables, emailed PDFs, and website copy.

system.$description: System fallback where Poppins is unavailable, and for client deliverables that cannot be saved as PDF.

weight.$description: Weight names used by the v2.0.1 type scale, mapped to their standard CSS numeric values.

black.$description: Listed as an available Roboto weight; not assigned to any type-scale style.

typography.$description: The 12 documented type styles, v2.0.1 section 3.2. Line height and letter spacing are transcribed as percentages exactly as the deck states them. fontFamily is the brand font; substitute {font.family.system} wherever Poppins is unavailable.

headline.$description: UNVERIFIED line height: the slide reads 24%, which at 20px would render 4.8px. Transcribed verbatim rather than corrected — confirm the intended value before relying on it. Weight, size and letter spacing are confirmed from the slide.
